exposure: elective Caesarean section (CS) at or beyond 36(0) weeks gestation
cohort: Late preterm and term babies born by elective CS from June 2010 to June 2014 at London Health Sciences Centre and St. Joseph's Health Care, Ontario, Canada
finding: The risk of respiratory morbidity was significantly higher following elective CS before 39 weeks gestation.
mod_finding: The risk of respiratory morbidity was significantly higher in infants born via elective cesarean section before 39 weeks gestation compared to those born at or after 39 weeks.
